title: RIID Formally Established Under Binod World Government Charter
author: Office of the President
summary: The Research, Intelligence, Investigation & Defense authority (RIID) is formally chartered as the Binod World Government's official intelligence, scientific security, and federal investigation authority, reporting directly to the Office of the President.
content:
The Binod World Government today announced the formal establishment of the Research, Intelligence, Investigation & Defense authority (RIID), consolidating the government's intelligence, scientific security, and federal investigation functions under a single accountable authority.

RIID will operate a public-facing portal for declassified case material, press releases, and recruitment, alongside a separate, secure Classified Intelligence Network for authorized personnel only.

RIID reports directly to the Office of the President and will coordinate closely with BIASR on matters of scientific security and with the Ministry of Internal Security on domestic investigations.

title: RIID Headquarters Groundbreaking Scheduled for 07 July 2026
author: RIID Office of Public Affairs
summary: Construction of the new RIID Headquarters begins 07 July 2026. The public can follow progress on the HQ Construction page.
content:
RIID confirmed today that groundbreaking on its permanent headquarters will begin 07 July 2026. The facility will house the Situation Room, Evidence Lab, Command Center, Server Room, and Archive Vault, alongside public-facing reception and recruitment offices.

Construction progress, Minecraft screenshots, and concept renders will be published on the HQ Construction page as work proceeds.
